summary: Test-writing phase for issue #39: added a committed solver parity corpus fixture (verbatim copy of color_matching's priv/parity/v1/corpus.json, 12 scenarios) and SolverParityCorpusTests.swift asserting WeightedSquaredErrorScorer scores, exclusions, and earliest-wins selection/tie-breaking (including via the real CompositionSolver) match the corpus exactly. Documented corpus consumption under docs/ (README update deferred to the implementation phase per TDD test-only boundary). No Swift toolchain is installed in this sandbox, so `swift test` could not be executed here; the corpus's expected scores/selections/ties were independently re-derived in Python from the same weighted-squared-error algorithm and all 12 scenarios matched exactly, but that is not a substitute for an actual `swift test` run. The OpenAPI client migration itself (swift-openapi-generator/runtime, PaletteAPIClient rewrite) is implementation work out of scope for this test-only run and is not attempted.
